## Description (paste as plain text)

Send a Christmas invitation your guests will love opening. It arrives as a wrapped gift box: one tap and the lid flies off, the card rises out of the box and golden stars fall across the screen. Pick one of 5 themes, edit it in minutes with no code, and share one link by WhatsApp, text or email.

✨ WHAT YOUR GUESTS SEE
• A wrapped Christmas gift with a satin bow and a "You're Invited" tag. One tap opens it
• The lid flies off, the card rises out and golden stars fall
• A garland of Christmas baubles and gently falling snow
• "CHRISTMAS Party" in big capitals and elegant script
• A live countdown to the party
• Date, time and address, with one-tap Google Maps directions
• Add to calendar (Apple, Google, Outlook)
• Dress code with colour suggestions and an optional sticker (for example "Ugly sweater required!")
• Schedule, menu, Secret Santa, "Good to Know" notes and a closing message (turn any section on or off)
• Built-in RSVP: guests choose yes or no, the number of guests, any allergies, and their Secret Santa wish list
• Tap the golden bells for a little Christmas surprise
• Optional music: Jingle Bells, Silent Night or We Wish You a Merry Christmas music box, or your own MP3. It only plays when a guest taps the music button

🎁 5 THEMES INCLUDED
• Red Velvet: deep crimson and shimmering gold
• Winter Frost: icy blue and silver with hanging snowflakes
• Gingerbread: cookie brown, icing dots and candy cane ribbon
• Evergreen: forest green, crisp white and a touch of gold
• Pink Christmas: pink, white and a pink Christmas tree
Switch theme with one click, as often as you like.

🎄 FOR ANY CHRISTMAS PARTY
The wording is written for you: Christmas Party, Christmas Dinner, Christmas Eve, Holiday Party, Office Christmas Party or Ugly Sweater Party. You can also change every word yourself.

📩 RSVPS STRAIGHT TO YOUR PHONE
Choose how replies reach you:
• WhatsApp: the guest's reply opens as a ready-to-send message to your number
• Email: the reply opens as a ready-to-send email to you
• Your own form link (for example a Google Form)
No account, no app and no monthly fees.

🖥 SO EASY TO EDIT
Open the editor in your browser and fill in a simple form. The invitation updates live as you type. Add your own photo, change every word, and save your draft to come back later. No coding and nothing to install.

✅ HOW IT WORKS
1. Purchase and download the files
2. Open the editor on a computer and fill in your details
3. Download your finished invitation
4. Publish it with Canva (step-by-step guide included) to get your link
5. Share your link by WhatsApp, text message or email

📦 WHAT YOU GET
• Easy editor (editor.html)
• Invitation template with all 5 themes (index.html)
• Step-by-step PDF guide

⚠️ PLEASE NOTE
• This is a digital download. No physical item will be shipped.
• Use a computer (laptop or desktop) to edit. Guests can open the invitation on any phone or computer.
• You need a Canva account to publish your invitation.
• RSVPs arrive by WhatsApp, email or your own form. There is no guest list dashboard.
• The Christmas tree, gifts and decorations are illustrations, not photos. You can add your own photo.
• For personal use. Please do not resell or share the files.
• I created this invitation and its editor with the help of AI tools.
• Because this is a digital product, returns are not accepted. If anything is unclear, send me a message and I'll gladly help.

Merry Christmas! 🎄
